en.headline: Man arrested in Tsuen Wan car park drug seizure
en.dek: Police detained a 34-year-old local man after finding about 27 grams of suspected ketamine and 23 grams of suspected cocaine valued at roughly HK$26,000 in two private cars.
body: Tsuen Wan District Special Duties Squad officers conducted an anti-narcotics operation at a residential car park in the district on Tuesday afternoon.

They stopped a 34-year-old local man who was seen transferring items between two private cars. A search of the vehicles yielded about 27 grams of suspected ketamine and 23 grams of suspected cocaine, with a total estimated street value of about HK$26,000.

The man was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs and remains in custody pending further inquiries. Police reminded the public that trafficking in dangerous drugs carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 荃灣停車場檢獲毒品 34歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方在荃灣住宅停車場截查兩輛私家車，檢獲約27克懷疑氯胺酮及23克懷疑可卡因，市值約2.6萬元，拘捕一名34歲本地男子。
body: 荃灣警區特別職務隊人員周二下午在區內一個住宅停車場展開反毒品行動。
人員發現一名34歲本地男子在私家車附近形跡可疑，懷疑他從一輛車的車尾箱搬運貨物到另一輛私家車。截查後在兩車內檢獲約27克懷疑氯胺酮及23克懷疑可卡因，市值約2.6萬元。
該名男子涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕，現正被扣留調查。警方提醒，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
